# SARTOR - Bespoke Atelier & Luxury Embroidery

> Premier women's bespoke tailoring atelier and luxury hand-embroidery house based at Moon Tower, Model Town, Lahore, Pakistan. Specializing in precision pattern cutting, handcrafted bridal lehengas, 16-kali kalidars, sarees, and bespoke couture for clients in Lahore and overseas diaspora brides in the UK, USA, Canada, and the UAE.

## Brand Overview & Atelier Identity

- **Atelier Location**: F-9 Moon Tower, International Market, Model Town, Lahore, Punjab 54700, Pakistan
- **Lead Cutting Authority**: Master Tailor Abdul Ghaffar (13+ years of master cutting authority, 35+ years heritage)

## Core Tailoring Disciplines & Expertise

- **13+ Years of Precision Cutting**: Anatomical grainline alignment (Seedha Taar) preventing seam twisting, ergonomic scye depth armhole curves, and 2.5-inch hidden alteration seam allowances.
- **Bespoke Bridal Wear & Lehengas**: Royal Barat lehengas, Walima gowns, and Farshi trails crafted on pure 80g/100g Katan raw silk with 3-tier canvas waistband suspensions.
- **16-Kali & 24-Kali Kalidars**: Panel-calculated kalidar frocks, anarkalis, and pishwas silhouettes with radial flare cutting.
- **Designer Sarees & Padded Blouses**: Pre-pleated falls, anti-slip waist binding, Habotai petticoats, and custom-sculpted padded bustiers.
- **Luxury Zardozi Hand Embroidery**: Generational wooden adda craftsmanship using authentic metallic bullion, coiled dabka, antique kora, nakshi, and micro-pearls.

## Atelier Services & Global Logistics

- **Lahore Doorstep Service**: Complimentary fabric pickup and finished garment delivery across Lahore (Model Town, DHA, Gulberg, Cantt, Johar Town, Bahria Town).
- **Overseas Diaspora Service (UK, USA, Canada, UAE)**: 1-on-1 guided biometric video measurement sessions ensuring 100% guaranteed custom fit without in-person visits.
- **Express Worldwide Shipping**: Insured priority delivery via DHL Express (3–5 business days to London, Toronto, New York, Houston, Dubai, Abu Dhabi).
- **Customs Threshold Compliance**: Documentation tailored to international de minimis thresholds ($800 US duty exemption, £135 UK threshold).
- **4-Step Milestone Payments**: 10% token booking, 30% adda sample approval, 30% mid-production video review, 30% final dispatch.
